_why: Names withdrawn at a person's request (see 99_Meta/withdrawn-videos.md and research_passes/2026-09-19-withdrawal-daniel-chalef.md). build_versions.py reconstructs chapter snapshots and commit subjects FROM GIT HISTORY, so a name removed from the working tree reappears in any snapshot generated for an older commit. These substitutions are applied to that reconstructed text before it is written. 'forbidden' is the fail-closed check: if a token survives substitution, the build stops rather than publishing the name.
